description:
Title: Contract

For your contract project you need parts from several web shops.
In order to find out which web shop has the right parts, you have to query them all, and find out how much they can deliver, at which price, and how long it will take.
Create a list of parts that you order from each shop.
If one shop has not enough  parts, order from several shops.
Always use the cheapest parts.
The parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically they are +/- 2 days earlier/later.
When the first parts arrive you start building.
Sometimes you have to reorder parts.
If your stock (for a single part) falls below 5, you reorder (the cheapest), if it falls below 3 you reorder again (the fastest).
If it is zero, you write a mail to your friends, complaining about the webshops.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Contract" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Query" name="Parts query"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Offer" name="Offer (quantity, price, delivery time)"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Order" name="Parts order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Batch" name="Parts batch"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Contract">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Project" name="Contract project" processRef="Process_Contract"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_WebShops" name="Web shops"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Query" name="Query parts" sourceRef="Task_Query" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Offers" name="Offers" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Order" name="Orders" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrders" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder (cheapest)" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder (fastest)" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Participant_WebShops"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Batch" name="Parts batch arrives" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_BatchArrives"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Parts are ordered from web shops and arrive in batches in random order (about +/- 2 days). Building starts when the first parts arrive. If the stock of a single part falls below 5, the cheapest parts are reordered; if it falls below 3, the fastest parts are reordered; if it is zero, a complaint mail is written.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Project" name="Contract project needs parts"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Query" name="Query web shops for quantity, price and delivery time" messageRef="Msg_Query"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive offers from web shops" messageRef="Msg_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Compare" name="Compare offers"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateList" name="Create list of parts to order per shop"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EnoughFromOne" name="Enough parts from one shop?" default="Flow_SeveralShops"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectOneShop" name="Select cheapest parts from one shop"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectSeveralShops" name="Select cheapest parts from several shops"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderMerge" name="Parts selected"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceOrders" name="Place orders with web shops" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ArrivalMerge" name="Parts expected"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_BatchArrives" name="Parts batch arrives">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Batch" messageRef="Msg_Batch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Build" name="Build with arrived parts"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockBelow5" name="Stock of a single part below 5?" default="Flow_Below5No"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder parts (cheapest)" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockBelow3" name="Stock below 3?" default="Flow_Below3No"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockZero" name="Stock zero?" default="Flow_ZeroNo"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_ComplaintMail" name="Write mail to friends complaining about web shops"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder parts (fastest)" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Complaint" name="Stock depleted, complaint sent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="Start_Project" targetRef="Task_Query"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_QueryToReceive" sourceRef="Task_Query" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveToCompare" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_Compare"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompareToList" sourceRef="Task_Compare" targetRef="Task_CreateList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ListToGateway" sourceRef="Task_CreateList" targetRef="Gateway_EnoughFromOne"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OneShop" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_EnoughFromOne" targetRef="Task_SelectOneShop">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${enoughFromOneShop}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SeveralShops" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_EnoughFromOne" targetRef="Task_SelectSeveralShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OneToMerge" sourceRef="Task_SelectOneShop" targetRef="Gateway_OrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SeveralToMerge" sourceRef="Task_SelectSeveralShops" targetRef="Gateway_OrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToOrder" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderMerge" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToArrival" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrders" targetRef="Gateway_ArrivalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArrivalToBatch" sourceRef="Gateway_ArrivalMerge" targetRef="Event_BatchArrives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BatchToBuild" sourceRef="Event_BatchArrives" targetRef="Task_Build"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuildToStock" sourceRef="Task_Build" targetRef="Gateway_StockBelow5"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Below5Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_StockBelow5" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stockLevel < 5}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Below5No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_StockBelow5" targetRef="Gateway_ArrivalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheapToBelow3" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_StockBelow3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Below3Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_StockBelow3" targetRef="Gateway_StockZero">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stockLevel < 3}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Below3No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_StockBelow3" targetRef="Gateway_ArrivalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ZeroYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_StockZero" targetRef="Task_ComplaintMail">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stockLevel == 0}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ZeroNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_StockZero" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MailToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ComplaintMail" targetRef="End_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FastToArrival" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Gateway_ArrivalMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
